_how: Manual fixes for news the data sources haven't caught up with. Each entry applies up to and including until_round, then is ignored. Fields: club (our code), pos, price, status (ok/doubtful/injured/out), pir (expected PIR per game, replaces the projection), why. The analyst adds entries from the user's news and removes expired ones.

Theo Maledon.why: Back from injury: 18 pts, 6 ast, PIR 29 in 16' at Baskonia (ACB, 15 Nov). Minutes still limited, so 15 rather than his pre-injury 20.

Kenan Kamenjas.why: Moved from Dubai to Baskonia (Gasteizhoy); the game still lists him at Dubai. Debut vs Real Madrid (ACB, 15 Nov): 15 pts, 8 reb, PIR 22 in 24' off the bench. Baskonia are short of bigs.

Nikolaos Rogkavopoulos.why: Back from injury (user report, 15 Nov; not yet confirmed in the press). Averaged 10.3 PIR in 12.7' before; 8 while he works back in.
